decisions.reason: The bushing-hole effect is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY setting bushing_holes to retain the existing holes unchanged.
The decision retains holes in the bushing and sliding mandrel and does not change any current main-shaft geometry attribute.
Retaining the existing holes does not alter the specified materials or the requirement to show materials on drawings.
The hole-retention decision does not change the fabrication sequence or the specified pre-weld and post-weld machining treatment of surfaces 1 and 2.
The decision concerns retaining bushing and sliding-mandrel holes, not the 45-degree relationship between lug hole axes.
The retained-hole geometry does not change the assembly-based drawing-numbering rule.
Although the retained holes must be reflected in the drawings, the source decision does not change the independently stated requirement to provide the manufacturing drawing set.
The source changes model content for the underlying mechanical features but does not change the requirement to deliver a 3D shaft assembly model.
